attributes.action: Bring forward the UK's Net Zero deadline and enforce stricter carbon budgets.
attributes.additional_details: Global greenhouse emissions are still hitting record highs. The current pace of climate action is not fast enough to prevent severe warming. Relying on distant deadlines allows politicians to delay necessary changes today.We need the Government to act with urgency. Speeding up our Net Zero targets will accelerate the transition away from fossil fuels, expand renewable energy, and force immediate drops in national emissions. Sign to demand faster action.
attributes.background: Bring forward the UK's legal Net Zero deadline to an earlier date. Enforce stricter yearly carbon budgets across all industries, scale up local green energy projects, and stop fossil fuel investments to cut emissions faster

rejection.details:
It is not clear what date you would like the UK Government to bring forward the UK's Net Zero target, and the measures you would like the UK Government or Parliament to implement in order to strengthen carbon budgets across all industries or scale up green energy projects.

The UK has already set legally-binding carbon budget targets, which you can find here: https://www.gov.uk/guidance/carbon-budgets

You may wish to create a new petition which clearly states the date you would like the Government to bring forward their Net Zero target, and the measures you would like the UK Government and Parliament to implement to ensure stricter carbon budgets and scaled up green energy projects.
